mapper.sql: select p.payable_id as payableId, p.enterprise_id as enterpriseId, p.payable_no as payableNo, p.order_id as orderId, p.supplier_id as supplierId, p.total_amount as totalAmount, p.paid_amount as paidAmount, p.due_date as dueDate, p.status as status, p.remark as remark, p.create_time as createTime, p.update_time as updateTime, s.supplier_name as supplierName, o.order_no as orderNo from t_payable p left join t_supplier s on s.supplier_id = p.supplier_id left join t_purchase_order o on o.order_id = p.order_id
mapper.insert: insert into t_payable (enterprise_id, payable_no, order_id, supplier_id, total_amount, paid_amount, due_date, status, remark, create_time) values (#{enterpriseId}, #{payableNo}, #{orderId}, #{supplierId}, #{totalAmount}, 0, #{dueDate}, '0', #{remark}, sysdate())
